AllowSignatureMethod.description_en:
The signature method used by the client. Valid values:

HmacSHA256

HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
AllowSignatureMethod.description_zh:
API的客户端请求签名方法，可选值：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256

AuthType.description_en:
The security authentication method of the API. Valid values:

APP: Only authorized applications can call the API.

ANONYMOUS: The API can be anonymously called. In this mode, you must take note of the following rules:

All users who have obtained the API service information can call this API. API Gateway does not authenticate callers and cannot set user-specific throttling policies. If you make this API public, set API-specific throttling policies
AuthType.description_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制

DisableInternet.description_en:
Specifies whether to set DisableInternet to true to limit API calls to within the VPC.

If you set DisableInternet to false, the limit is lifted.

If you do not set this parameter, the original value is not modified
DisableInternet.description_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用。

修改API时，不设置则不修改原来的取值

FailResultSample.description_en: The sample error response from the backend service
FailResultSample.description_zh: 后端服务失败返回应答的示例

ForceNonceCheck.description_en:
Specifies whether to set ForceNonceCheck to true to force the check of X-Ca-Nonce during the request. This is the unique identifier of the request and is generally identified by UUID. After receiving this parameter, API Gateway verifies the validity of this parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This helps prevent replay attacks.

If you set ForceNonceCheck to false, the check is not performed. The default value is false when you create an API
ForceNonceCheck.description_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。

设置ForceNonceCheck为false，则不检查。创建API时默认为false

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the API group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the API group

OpenIdConnectConfig.description_en: The configuration items of the third-party OpenID Connect authentication method
OpenIdConnectConfig.description_zh: 第三方账号认证OpenID Connect相关配置项

IdTokenParamName.description_en: The name of the parameter that corresponds to the token

OpenIdApiType.description_en:
The configuration of OpenID Connect authentication. Valid values:

IDTOKEN: indicates the APIs that are called by clients to obtain tokens. If you specify this value, the PublicKeyId parameter and the PublicKey parameter are required.

\BUSINESS: indicates business APIs. Tokens are used to call the business APIs. If you specify this value, the IdTokenParamName parameter is required
OpenIdApiType.description_zh:
OpenID Connect模式，目前可以取值：

IDTOKEN：获取授权API，颁发Token，当设置此项时，参数PublicKeyId和PublicKey为必传。
BUSINESS：业务API，Token验证，当设置此项时，参数IdTokenParamName为必传

PublicKey.description_en: The public key of the API

PublicKeyId.description_en: The ID of the public key

RegionId.description_en: The region to which the API group belongs

RequestConfig.description_en:
Configuration items of API requests sent by the consumer to API Gateway.

For more information, see [RequestConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43985.html）
RequestConfig.description_zh:
Consumer向网关发送API请求的相关配置项。

更多信息，请参见[RequestConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43985.html）

BodyFormat.description_en:
This parameter takes effect only when the RequestMode parameter is set to MAPPING.

The server data transmission method used for POST and PUT requests. Valid values: FORM and STREAM. FORM indicates that data in key-value pairs is transmitted as forms. STREAM indicates that data is transmitted as byte streams
BodyFormat.description_zh:
当RequestMode值为MAPPING时有效。

POST/PUT请求时，表示数据以何种方式传递给服务器，取值为：FORM、STREAM，分别表示表单形式(k-v对应)、字节流形式

PostBodyDescription.description_en: The description of the request body

RequestHttpMethod.description_en: The HTTP method used to make the request. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS

RequestMode.description_en:
The request mode. Valid values:

MAPPING: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are filtered out.

PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are passed through.

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are passed through
RequestMode.description_zh:
入参请求的模式，取值为：

MAPPING：入参映射（过滤未知参数）

PASSTHROUGH：入参透传

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH：入参映射（透传未知参数）

RequestPath.description_en: The API request path. If the complete API URL is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the API request path is `/object/add `
RequestPath.description_zh: API path，比如API的完全地址为`http://api.a.com：8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，path是指`/object/add`这一部分

RequestProtocol.description_en: The protocol type supported by the API. Valid values: HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket. Separate multiple values with commas (,), such as "HTTP,HTTPS"
RequestProtocol.description_zh: API 支持的协议类型，可以多选，多选情况下以英文逗号隔开，如："HTTP,HTTPS"，取值为：HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket

ResultBodyModel.description_en: The return description of the API

ResultSample.description_en: The sample response from the backend service
ResultSample.description_zh: 后端服务返回应答的示例

ResultType.description_en: The format of the response from the backend service. Valid values: JSON, TEXT, BINARY, XML, and HTML. Default value: JSON
ResultType.description_zh: 后端服务返回应答的格式，目前可以设置为：JSON、TEXT、BINARY、XML、HTML。默认为JSON

ServiceConfig.description_en:
The configuration items of API requests sent by API Gateway to the backend service.

For more information, see [ServiceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43987.html）
ServiceConfig.description_zh:
网关向后端服务发送API请求的相关配置项。

更多信息，请参见[ServiceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43987.html）

FunctionComputeConfig.description_en: Backend configuration items when the backend service is Function Compute
FunctionComputeConfig.description_zh: 后端为函数计算时的后端配置项

ContentTypeCatagory.description_en:
The ContentType header type used when you call the backend service over HTTP.

DEFAULT: the default header type in API Gateway.

CUSTOM: a custom header type.

\CLIENT: the ContentType header type of the client
ContentTypeCatagory.description_zh:
调用后端服务HTTP服务时，ContentType头的取值策略：

DEFAULT：使用API网关默认的值
CUSTOM：自定义
CLIENT：使用客户端上行的ContentType的头

ContentTypeValue.description_en: The value of the ContentType header when the ServiceProtocol parameter is set to HTTP and the ContentTypeCatagory parameter is set to DEFAULT or CUSTOM
ContentTypeValue.description_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP服务，ContentTypeCatagory的值为DEFAULT或者CUSTOM时，ContentType头的取值

FcBaseUrl.description_en: The root path of Function Compute

FcType.description_en: The type of the Function Compute instance

FunctionName.description_en: The function name defined in Function Compute

OnlyBusinessPath.description_en: The backend only receives the service path

RegionId.description_en: The region where the API is located

RoleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role to be assumed by API Gateway to access Function Compute
RoleArn.description_zh: Ram授权给API网关访问函数计算的arn

ServiceName.description_en: The service name defined in Function Compute

Mock.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Mock mode. Valid values:

TRUE: The Mock mode is enabled.

\FALSE: The Mock mode is not enabled
Mock.description_zh:
是否采取Mock模式，目前可以取值：

TRUE：启用Mock模式
FALSE：不启用Mock模式

MockResult.description_en: The result returned when the Mock mode is enabled
MockResult.description_zh: 如果启用Mock模式，返回的结果

MockStatusCode.description_en: The status code returned for service mocking

ServiceAddress.description_en: The URL used to call the back-end service. If the complete back-end service URL is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the value of ServiceAddress is http\://api.a.com:8080.\`\`
ServiceAddress.description_zh: 调用后端服务地址，比如后端服务完全地址为`http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，ServiceAddress是指`http://api.a.com:8080`这一部分

ServiceHttpMethod.description_en: The HTTP method used to call a backend service. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS
ServiceHttpMethod.description_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP协议时的Method，取值为：GET、POST、DELETE、PUT、HEADER、TRACE、PATCH、CONNECT、OPTIONS

ServicePath.description_en: The path used to call the back-end service. If the complete back-end service path is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, ServicePath is /object/add.\`\`
ServicePath.description_zh: 调用后端服务path，比如后端服务完全地址为`http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，ServicePath是指`/object/add`这一部分

ServiceProtocol.description_en: The backend service protocol. Currently, only HTTP, HTTPS, and FunctionCompute are supported
ServiceProtocol.description_zh: 后端服务协议类型，目前只支持HTTP/HTTPS/FunctionCompute

ServiceTimeout.description_en: The timeout period of the backend service, in millisecond
ServiceTimeout.description_zh: 后端服务超时时间，单位：毫秒

ServiceVpcEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the VPC channel. Valid values:

TRUE: The VPC channel is enabled. You must create the corresponding VPC access authorization before you can enable a VPC channel.

FALSE: The VPC channel is not enabled
ServiceVpcEnable.description_zh:
是否启用VPC通道，目前可以取值：

TRUE：启用VPC通道，必须先添加VPC授权成功后才能启用
FALSE：不启用VPC通

VpcConfig.description_en: Configuration items related to VPC channels

InstanceId.description_en: The IDs of the ELB and SLB instances in the VPC
InstanceId.description_zh: 专用网络中的实例ID（Ecs/负载均衡）

Name.description_en: The name of the VPC access authorization

Port.description_en: The port number that corresponds to the instance

Visibility.description_en:
Specifies whether to make the API public. Valid values:

PUBLIC: Make the API public. If you set this parameter to PUBLIC, this API is displayed on the APIs page for all users after the API is published to the production environment.\

PRIVATE: Make the API private. Private APIs are not displayed in the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace after the API group to which they belong is made available
Visibility.description_zh:
API是否公开，可以取值：

PUBLIC：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境定义，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面可见。
PRIVATE：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
